title: How Search Engine Impacts Market Structure: Empirical Evidence from a Multivendor Darknet Market
authors: Ying Lu; Dandan Qiao; Shu He; Bernard C. Y. Tan
eligible_reason: GRAMS entry is a single common date: after = 1 after April 15, 2014 for all units; treat = market indexed by GRAMS (checked in websitepanel.csv: all five indexed markets switch on in week 2014-16; five markets never indexed). Canonical 2x2 DiD, not staggered. Vendor-level main columns also add website x after interactions and heterogeneity interactions; GSC is reported separately.
design_notes: R (plm, within, twoways). website_regressions.R: plm(y ~ treat*after, index=c('website','week_no'), effect='twoways') for trans_num, itemtype_num, ven_num, gini_vendor, gini_2ndcat (10 websites, 378 website-weeks). vendor_regressions_main_sample.R: plm(trans_num ~ treat*after + website-specific interactions, index=c('vendor_unit_name','week_no')) on leading-vendor and pre-GRAMS-leadership subsamples; category_regressions.R analogous at 2nd-level category. Also generalized synthetic control (gsynth) and Stata parallel-trend test.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: All GRAMS-indexed markets treated from week 2014-16.

specs.exclusion_reason: single common adoption date (April 15, 2014), not staggered

data_files_note: Built from the public gwern darknet-market archive; all panels shipped.
software_notes: R (plm, gsynth); one Stata do-file for parallel-trend test.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (ReadMe.pdf, R scripts, websitepanel.csv).
